basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school teacher based in the Midwest, with a passion for technology and music festivals. I love exploring new gadgets and often find myself helping friends and family with tech issues. When I'm not teaching or online, I enjoy attending music festivals like Peach Music Fest and diving deep into anime series, particularly OreGairu. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after dinner, around 8 PM to 11 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Education with a minor in Computer Science, which ignited my interest in technology. Over the years, I've honed my skills through online courses and by tackling real-world tech problems, both in my personal life and for the school where I work.
